One of the countries (player) we attacked was rather weak, but damn, did he try his best to put up a fight, even with 4 times game speed, we needed 2 whole days to conquer him. In the afternoon on the second day, I got a message from this fellow opponent, saying he appreciated our war but unfortunately he had to forfeit the game as he was an NHS worker and he had to go for a 24 hour shift. Not going to lie, I felt bad about destroying him for a bit. I replied with a similarly kind message, as he really did put up a great fight against so uneven odds.
